suppressions.rationale: Only the ticket-search-field--grow and --open root modifiers styled in ticket-search-field.css: the workspace header's expanded search keeps a plain 19rem floor because Kerf's sizing="grow" min(100%, basis) floor drops out of a content-sized trailing zone and wraps the field in a wide header (KF-K4VBTS). Every other HS2-8FS5BJ hook now uses Kerf props (HS2-DAMHD1). Remove with HS2-AEK8GK.
